body.p: This book was produced entirely from DITAsource formatDITA XML source files using the dita2epub pluginversiondita2epub plugin (version 1.5.0) for DITA-OTDITA Open Toolkit 4.4.

The transformation from DITA to EPUB 3.3EPUB 3.3 was performed by XSLT 3.0 stylesheets processing a bookmap with eighteen topics, ten glossary entries, and approximately one hundred index terms. Java utilities handled font obfuscation, image optimization, and EPUB packaging.

The cover was designed as a scalable vector graphic (SVG) for resolution independence. Body text is set in the reading system's default serif font. Code samples use the default monospace font. Headings use the system sans-serif stack.

The default stylesheet provides responsive typography with a 16px base size, 1.6 line-height, and CSS hyphenation. Color-coded admonitions, zebra-striped tables, numbered figures, and footnotes with backlinks are all handled automatically.
The EPUB was validated with EPUBCheckEPUBCheck and conforms to the EPUB 3.3 specification and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.
Source code and issue tracker: github.com/jyjeanne/dita2epub
